fee_details:
- 1st Year: Rs.500 waived if HDFC Current/Savings Account is opened and Rs.5000 is spent within 3 months of card approval.
- 2nd Year Onwards: Rs.500 waived if annual spends exceed Rs.50000 on HDFC Current/Savings Account(s) opened previously.
- NPR: Rs.500 per annum
reward_structure:
- Online shopping: 4 points/ Rs.150
- Others: 2 points/ Rs.150
key_highlights:
- A Cashback credit card with minimal fee
- Joining fee and annual fee waived when applied through BankBazaar (T&C apply).
- Accelerated reward points on online purchases
- Reward points redemption for cash against card outstanding.

benefits_features.Welcome Gift: Apply for the MoneyBack credit card and earn 500 reward points as a joining bonus. Renew your card, and you will get 500 more reward points.
benefits_features.Milestone rewards: Spend Rs.50,000 or more in retail purchases in a quarter and get a voucher worth Rs.500. This voucher has a validity of 60 days.
benefits_features.Cashback Benefits:
- 2x reward points on retail spends, 2 times more points on online spends.
- Redeem reward points for cash (100 reward points = Rs.50).
benefits_features.Save on fuel purchases: With the fuel surcharge waiver facility, you can save up to Rs.1,000 per year on your fuel purchases at petrol stations across India. Offer is valid on minimum transaction value of Rs.500.
benefits_features.Zero liability on lost card: While reporting the loss of your credit card, you will have zero liability on any fraudulent transactions made using your card.
benefits_features.Reward points program:
- Earn 2 reward points on every Rs.150 spent on the card.
- Earn 2x more reward points on online spends.
- Redeem earned reward points for cash (against card outstanding): 100 reward points = Rs.50;
Also redeemable for air miles and gifts via reward/exchanger catalogue.
- Minimum 2500 points are required for redemption. The reward points are valid for 2 years from the date of accumulation.

how_tos.How to Apply for HDFC MoneyBack Credit C:
You can apply for HDFC MoneyBack Credit Card from HDFC official website. Follow the steps to apply now:
- Navigate to the required page to apply for MoneyBack Credit Card.
- Click on the option to fill the required details to check your eligibility for the card.
- If you're eligible, you will find an option to select and apply for the card.
- Click on the option to submit the required details and documents and press "Submit".
On successful submission of required documents and details, you will receive an acknowledgement message carrying the application ID. You can use the same to track your card application status at the later stage.

miscellaneous: The credit limit on HDFC Bank MoneyBack Credit Card will vary depending on your credit score. The bank determines the credit limit, as well as the cash limit on the card, separately for each applicant. The credit limit for cardholders will be based on the credit score of the primary applicant, the credit report along with the repayment habits of past and ongoing credit cards.

faqs.What is the credit limit on HDFC MoneyBa: HDFC MoneyBack Credit Card does not specify a credit card limit. The limit varies for each applicant and is allotted based on their income range and credit score; however, the maximum limit you expect on the MoneyBack Credit Card is in the range of Rs. 5 lakh while the minimum would be Rs.25,000 once you apply and receive the card; talk to the corporate to communicate the credit limit at the time of disbursement.
faqs.Can we make payment from HDFC MoneyBack: Yes, you can only pay via your HDFC account, make the payment by selecting your Paytm account or your PhonePe account linked to either of the above money on the Paytm/PhonePe directly or make the payment to the other via your HDFC account at the time of payment. None of the above-mentioned transactions are chargeable.
faqs.What are the core benefits of HDFC Money: As the MoneyBack Card belongs to the regular category, it provides accelerated reward points; the other offers for some known kinds of the transactions to the card includes a regular cash-back on the bill against purchases; it also provides money-back benefits at the requirement of a higher number of points for redemption of several benefits such as travel, dining, etc.
faqs.How can I redeem my reward points on HDF: Reward points on the MoneyBack credit card can be redeemed for cash, air miles, or if you wish to redeem cash for redeem, you need to have a minimum of 2,500 points. Once you earn them, you can select cash, as your redemption and your outstanding card balance will be adjusted with the equivalent cash benefits. Every 100 points would give you Rs.50.
faqs.Can you get an add-on card in addition t: Yes, you can apply for a supplementary card for your immediate family members older than 18 years. The add-on card is free for lifetime and carries all the benefits of the primary card.
